rulings.item: 5 enumerations without enumerators (enum __pid_type, __ptrace_request, __rlimit_resource, __vlimit_resource, mcheck_status) and their 14 users (mcheck, mcheck_pedantic, mprobe, prlimit, prlimit64, ptrace, vlimit) excepted

rulings.item: bindresvport6 and getumask: declared by the reference, no default-version export

rulings.item: table depth gap: siginfo_t _sifields._sigfault._bounds, __atomic_wide_counter.__value32 (pthread_cond_t, struct __pthread_cond_s), struct __res_state sort_list have no rows below them
rulings.recommendation: extend the layouts extraction to every depth

rulings.item: __SOCKADDR_ARG / __CONST_SOCKADDR_ARG: no table gives the transparent union's members or the macro form; the generator emits an opaque 8-byte typedef (8 functions excepted in C++)
rulings.recommendation: layouts rows for the union and a macro row for the pointer form, before sys/socket.h is generated

rulings.item: 18 pointer-valued macros (NULL, SIG_*, MAP_FAILED, RTLD_*, FE_*_ENV, MM_NULL*, ...) have constants.tsv values but no macros.tsv type
rulings.recommendation: a macros.tsv pointer type so the value emitter spells the cast

rulings.item: FNM_NOSYS, DLFO_EH_SEGMENT_TYPE, TD_SIGNO_MASK: constants.tsv value, no macros.tsv row
rulings.recommendation: add their macros.tsv rows (check whether TD_SIGNO_MASK is function-like)

rulings.item: 10 type-generic macros with a visibility kind function, and gets, bsd_signal without a prototypes.tsv row
rulings.recommendation: function rows for their function forms (or a visibility kind for type-generic forms), prototypes rows for gets and bsd_signal

rulings.item: va_list member offsets in C++ (__va_list_tag is no class there)
